description: This file is a shell script used for creating UBI images, involving partition layout and configuration, with functions to define volumes and assemble the image layout based on input parameters.

methods.name: ubivol
methods.description: Defines a UBI volume with specified parameters and outputs configuration directives.

methods.name: ubilayout
methods.description: Sets up the layout of UBI volumes, including optional uboot environment, kernel, root filesystem, and their sizes.

methods.name: set_ubinize_seq
methods.description: Sets the sequence string for ubinize if SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is defined.
